Name: Tappable Palm Trees
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod adds a tap product (default: [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Oil][b]Oil[/b][/url]) to palm trees in the desert and Ginger Island (and your farm if you have a plantable palm tree mod).

By default it takes around 5 days for a palm tree to produce its product.

You can change the product and the days in the config using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿, or editing the [b]config.json[/b] file.

The product can be a vanilla index or vanilla name; DGA and JA names should work as well.


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
